public_rationale: On the ordinary economic reading, the filing describes a real transition beyond its historical financial snapshot. It identifies changing infrastructure arrangements and payment timing, as well as expected slower growth. This supports the documentary claim. It does not establish a different legal issuer or guarantee worse financial results by the listing date.
limitations: The result depends on reading the metaphor as a claim about changing business economics.
A literal claim that the transformation must be complete on the IPO date is not established.
